title: Unchosen cards from Lightning Rush's look-at-top-3 are recycled to the bottom of the Main Deck instead of put into the trash
expected: Parser drops the "Put the rest into your trash." clause: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-draw.ts:139 returns bare `{ amount, from, type: "look" }` for Lightning Rush (ven.json:4460 abilities is [null], so runtime parse is used). The engine then defaults the rest-destination to recycle: packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/look.ts:53 `onRest = lookEff.onRest ?? (visionLike ? undefined : "recycle")`, and the only supported onRest value is "recycle" (look.ts:40, types/game-state.ts:522). pending-choice.ts:1466-1472/1793 moves the unpicked revealed cards to mainDeck position "bottom". No trash destination exists for look-rest, so the 2 unchosen cards go to deck bottom instead of trash, matching the observation.
observed: pendingChoice was {type:'reveal-and-pick', onPicked:'draw', onRest:'recycle'}; after picking Gust, trash count stayed at 1 (only Lightning Rush itself), deck went 35->34, and server state showed the two unpicked cards (player-1-main-14-unl-127-219, player-1-main-35-sfd-005-221) at mainDeck indices 68/69 (bottom). Reproduced again on the Flow replay (unpicked cards at mainDeck 65/66 of 67, trash 0). The spell ability loaded for the card is just {type:'look', amount:3, from:'deck'} with no rest->trash destination (ven.json abilities entry is [null]).

history.note: parser emits onRest:'trash' for 'Put the rest into your trash'; pending-choice moves unpicked revealed cards to trash

resolution.note: PARTIAL: parser now emits onRest:'trash' (landed f557cdb). The engine half (pending-choice.ts moves unpicked revealed cards to trash + game-state.ts onRest type) is written in the working tree but could not be landed — another lane's uncommitted pending-choice.ts/spell-modes.ts WIP blocks that file. Repro left as test.failing in __tests__/cards/ven-156-166.test.ts and will re-enqueue.
